articles.summary: BOLTON, Ontario, Feb. 18, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) — GPGI, Inc. (NYSE: GPGI) today announced executive leadership transitions at its segment, Husky Technologies™ (“Husky” or the “Company”). Husky Chief Executive Officer, Bradley Selleck, and Chief Financial Officer, John Linker, will depart the company in April and March, 2026, respectively. articles.title: GPGI, Inc. Announces Executive Leadership Transitions at its Segment, Husky Technologies
